status: Validated for the stated static scope and one matched trial per arm; all material findings from three consultation rounds accounted for.
request: Review the skills and decide whether they need updating; apply the approved updates and open a PR from origin/main. This change aligns worktrunk and stacked-pr with the installed wt v0.80.0 and gh stack v0.2.0 (gh 2.102.0).

changes.change: wt owns every worktree operation; raw git worktree only on explicit user request, and an unavailable wt is a blocker. wt merge commits uncommitted and untracked changes, squashes, rebases, fast-forwards the local target without fetching and removes the worktree and branch; run it only when the user asks, after confirming the worktree holds only intended changes.

Removal runs in the background unless --foreground; completion reads branch_outcome from --foreground --format=json (deleted, retained_*, not_attempted, deferred). New bulk-cleanup section for wt step prune with its skips (main, locked, dirty, younger than --min-age, unapproved hooks) and a --dry-run preview.

pre-merge and post-merge hooks; pre-commit runs only before Worktrunk's own commits; wt step copy-ignored and .worktreeinclude for caches; experimental wt step tether for dev servers; wt config approvals list --format=json reads approval state without prompting.

Read the new path from wt switch --format=json and run one program with -x (explicit shell for shell syntax); --full means CI status and LLM summaries; dimmed rows were clean when listed; user pre-* hooks run first while post-* hooks start together; fish shell integration and wt hook <type> --foreground for post-hook debugging.

No CLI command removes only the GitHub grouping: unstack also drops local tracking, re-adopt with init once the stack view no longer reports the chain, otherwise follow the migration decision step. On the link path publish missing PRs through the pr skill first and pass existing PRs by URL. gh stack modify uses clean owning worktrees; manual and API routes still replay explicitly.

--open also marks existing PRs ready; gh stack push leases per branch and is not atomic; pass the approved target and method to non-interactive merge; no read-only CLI command inspects a remote stack, and gh pr view does not report membership.
Refreshed the worktrunk entrypoint hash and the catalog cache key. stacked-pr/SKILL.md is unchanged.

consultations.brief: .agents/skill-refresh/cli-brief.md, cli-brief-r2.md, cli-brief-r3.md (scratch, not committed): user request, frozen candidate diff, audit evidence, global worktree rule; read-only, no delegation.

profiles.result: No material issues; minor: wt merge stages and commits uncommitted changes by default.

One material (wt merge side effects and gate) and seven minor findings: flags where removal is chosen, not_attempted, prune approval skips and --min-age default, -x without a shell, unstack partial dissolution, publishing missing PRs before link, wt hook --foreground.

rounds.adopted: All findings, including dropping the PR-repository condition on wt merge in favor of a user request in any repository.
